compilerStages: Validate exact reference/configuration and raw supported nodes
Compile a separately named course policy with unresolved branches visible
Re-evaluate policy and all compared deviations before using its ranges/answers
Select candidate relations and useful controlled comparisons
Build one demonstration, one partial completion, then exposure-separated independent use
Attach only to the current four-step parent; restore full state on return
Publish only the question domain whose required inputs passed

policyTransforms.visual_only: Hide or progressively reveal information; strategy identity remains unchanged.
policyTransforms.frequency_quantization: Map mixed frequencies to an explicit discrete policy and recompute affected ancestors.
policyTransforms.menu_restriction: Remove actions only with a new policy evaluation and a declared continuation.
policyTransforms.route_packaging: Reorder help and independent practice without changing the underlying policy; mark demonstrated steps as assisted.

rangeUpdateFormula: q_after(h,a)=q_before(h)*p(a|h,node); normalize by the total branch mass. For unknown opponents, apply the action probabilities to legal joint private-hand pairs before marginalizing.
sequenceContract: First pass follows one parent route: identify board and hand strength, compare ranges, choose current action, update pot and ranges, deal next street, act again, then settle. Child explanations open on demand and return to the exact parent snapshot; 35 units are coverage checks, not a flat learner menu.

publicationChecks.sourceQuality: Saved strategy, raw numeric/export consistency and actual convergence are separate checks; no global metric is a per-action EV tolerance.
publicationChecks.natureSampling: Use supported joint private pairs followed by uniform physical cards, or the matching conditional chance law; do not replace weighted-range conditioning with uniform public-card sampling.
publicationChecks.perTaskScope: Distinguish physical fact, explicit course prescription, single-step strategic proposal, given demonstration, and actually committed continuous play.
publicationChecks.continuousClosure: Every accepted committed action and supported future card requires a matched continuation/reference or a separately validated query path. Selected node exports alone are not a complete trainer.
publicationChecks.zeroReach: A legal deviation with zero reference support is not learner illegality and its reported zero EV is not a usable answer; require an explicit counterfactual completion or suspend strategic grading.
publicationChecks.packaging: Keep full author references separate from compiled lesson packets; document runtime memory and reference identity for any full-tree query service. No learner-facing solver settings or database are implied.
